title: nixos/beszel: allow S.M.A.R.T monitoring
reason: Real new smartmon.{enable,package,deviceAllow} submodule added, plus real systemd hardening/capability adjustments (AmbientCapabilities, DeviceAllow, NoNewPrivileges, PrivateDevices, PrivateUsers all conditioned on smartmon.enable). File was previously logged as a 'pure blackout, no resolved lead' instance earlier in the S5-B round -- this PR retests it with a fresh option.
targets_toml: Self-corrected: option_prefix=[services,beszel,agent,smartmon] (prefix ending at the bare nested attrset 'smartmon') gave 0 discovered_options -- same class of mistake as porxie/tlsrpt/peertube/kanidm this round. Corrected to option_prefix=[services,beszel,agent], watch=['smartmon.enable'], which found 6 discovered_options.

Importantly, this file is NOT a blackout this time -- with correct targeting the option IS discovered; the earlier 'pure blackout' logging for beszel-agent may itself have been a targeting artifact rather than a real tool gap, worth revisiting if this file recurs.
